ideas.pitch: A low-cost handheld multispectral scanner and offline Edge AI device that diagnoses crop nutrient deficiencies and fungal infections instantly in rural fields without internet connectivity.
ideas.title: KrishiScanner: Offline AI Soil & Leaf Health Diagnostic Node
ideas.why_it_could_win: Hardware builds naturally stand out in room filled with web apps, and running AI locally on constrained silicon directly mirrors the engineering patterns seen in winning IoT and edge-computing hackathon projects.

ideas.pitch: An automated community water filtration monitoring system that uses real-time pH and turbidity sensors to detect contamination spikes, triggering automated isolation valves and cloud alerts.
ideas.title: JalSuraksha: IoT-Enabled Rural Water Quality Telemetry & Auto-Flush System
ideas.why_it_could_win: Judges prioritize projects targeting core civic infrastructure and public health impacts. Having a physical sensor loop that responds in real-time makes for an undeniable live demo.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered system that ingests vernacular customer support audio and government service interactions, running local speech-to-text and sentiment analytics to flag fraud or mis-selling in local dialects.
ideas.title: BhashaAudit: Multimodal Regional Language Compliance & Audio Verification Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages complex multimodal AI pipelines to solve a uniquely Indian systemic bottleneck, addressing high-impact socio-economic challenges with working code.

ideas.pitch: A hardware-secured tracking tool combining conductive ink signatures on product packaging with a handheld ESP32 scanner to instantly verify supply chain authenticity and detect counterfeits.
ideas.title: AyurVerify: Tamper-Evident Supply Chain Tracker for Ayurvedic Formulations
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly applies proven anti-counterfeiting hardware architectures that previously won major national hackathons, showing high technical ambition and immediate commercial feasibility.

ideas.pitch: An intelligent energy-monitoring platform that consumes streaming telemetry from regional sub-stations, uses fast unsupervised ML to spot power theft or transformer anomalies, and visualizes fixes on a live map.
ideas.title: VidyutGrid: Automated Micro-Grid Load Balancing & Anomaly Detection Dashboard
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines robust streaming data backends with rapid anomaly detection models, fulfilling the software track's demand for intelligent systems and automation tools that solve industrial problems.
